findings.title: Coach search filters are cleared after using browser back button from a profile
findings.description: On the coach browse/search page, users set filters (specialty, language, timezone), click into a coach's profile to read the bio, then use the browser back button to return to the list. All filter selections are wiped, forcing users to re-enter every filter from scratch. Observed on Chrome (customer's fleet is Chrome-only, so other browsers unconfirmed). Impact scales with the number of filters set — users with several filters (e.g., language + specialty + timezone) are hit hardest and are most likely to abandon the search; the customer reports at least two users who gave up on booking because of the repeated resets. A workaround exists: opening each coach profile in a new tab instead of clicking through preserves the list tab's filters, but users don't discover this naturally.
findings.quote: Then they click into a coach's profile to read the bio. And then they hit the browser back button to go back to the list — and all their filters are gone. Wiped. Back to square one.
findings.severity_reason: Real, reproducible usability defect causing reported search abandonment and lost bookings, but a workaround (open profile in new tab) exists and it does not block core product use.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue covers coach-search filter state loss on back navigation; distinct from all listed bugs/features, so this is new.

findings.title: New-tab workaround for coach search filter reset
findings.description: One user found that opening each coach profile in a new tab (rather than clicking through and using back) preserves the filters on the original list tab. This is a customer-side workaround for the filter-reset bug, not a separate product issue.
findings.quote: The one clever guy opens each coach profile in a new tab instead of clicking through. Then the list tab keeps its filters.
findings.severity_reason: Not a distinct defect; it is a stopgap for the filter-reset bug already captured.
findings.match_note: Directly tied to the browser-back filter-reset issue raised at L24; filed as workaround_request rather than a separate ticket.
